sections.heading: Measuring UV intensity
paragraphs: An ultravoilet light is divided into three bands i.e. UVA, UVB, UVC.
There are three fundamental parameters for UV measurement. These are wavelength, energy density and irradiance.
bullets: UVA : It is a long wave UV transparent wavelength, 315 nm to 400 nm UV transparent. It causes skin tan, skin elasticity and collagen fibers. Uses: Curing Lamps in the Curing Industries.

UVB : It is a medium wave UV with erythema effect, wavelength 280 nm to 320 nm. It promotes Vitamin D formation in body, but exposure for long time is not recommended. Uses : In Health care Physiotherapy Lamps
UVC : It is a short wave with bacterial effect wavelength, 200 nm to 280 nm. It is very harmful, and its long term exposure causes skin Cancer. Uses: In Hospitals Germicidal Lamps
Wavelength: To measure the wavelength we require a Spectroradiometer (they can measure individual peaks) or Spectrometer.

Irradiance: Intensity is the output energy of UV source. The amount of UV falling on a surface is called irradiance. A cm2 is the area which is used to track the UV from all angles and is determined by direct measurements. It is measured in Watt/cm2 or mW/cm2 .
UV Energy Density:It is exposure of UV light with time factor. That is 1 watt for 1 sec equal 1 joule. It is measured in Joules/cm2 or mJ/cm2 .

sections.heading: UV Instrument
paragraphs: Now it is very important to understand your UV measuring instrument. It will help you and the customers to better understand the readings.
